description: This source file implements utility functions for NGAP ASN.1 message processing, including extracting cause strings, message types, and UE IDs (RAN and AMF) from various NGAP message structures, supporting 3GPP specifications.

methods.name: get_cause_str
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the cause based on its type in NGAP cause_c structure.

methods.name: get_message_type_str
methods.description: Returns a string describing the NGAP message type from ngap_pdu_c structure.

methods.name: get_ran_ue_id
methods.description: Extracts the RAN UE ID from various NGAP message structures, including init, success, and failure messages.

methods.name: get_amf_ue_id
methods.description: Extracts the AMF UE ID from various NGAP message structures, including init, success, and failure messages.
